card.name: Withdraw in drug preparation steps
card.fires_on: The verb "withdraw" (or "withdrawn") at the start of a preparation step, usually after reconstitution or dilution of a vial. Also weaker on "taped" and the end of "vial".

modes.label: Withdraw instruction
modes.description: The verb withdraw begins a step telling the preparer to draw a volume out of a vial or bag.
modes.example: Withdraw>> 3 mL of the vial contents

modes.label: Withdrawn volume
modes.description: The past form "withdrawn" refers back to a volume already drawn out.
modes.example: Add the<< withdrawn>> volume of drug (step 3)

modes.label: Other procedure verbs
modes.description: A procedural verb such as taped, or the end of the word vial, in preparation or administration text.
modes.example: with the tip well into the sigmoid colon, and<< taped>> into place.
